name: Can I stay in my home during a primary bedroom addition?

mainEntity.name: Can I stay in my home during a primary bedroom addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: Whether you can stay in your home during a primary bedroom addition depends on the project's scope and the extent of disruption. For smaller additions with minimal impact on essential utilities, staying might be feasible. However, projects involving extensive structural work, utility shutdowns, or significant dust and noise may necessitate temporary relocation for comfort and safety. We establish clear communication regarding potential disruptions and help plan for phases that might require alternative living arrangements.
acceptedAnswer.description: Staying home during an addition depends on project scope and disruption. Smaller projects may allow it, but extensive structural work or utility shutdowns might require temporary relocation.
